display.name: Cormorant Garamond
display.rationale: Brand-specified display family; used generously for editorial authority without substituting another luxury serif.

body.name: Inter
body.rationale: Brand-specified body family; used for precise clinical utility copy, actions, disclaimers, and diagram labels.

h1.rationale: Large lyrical display headlines carry the premium editorial voice while maintaining clear physician-planning specificity.

h2.rationale: Section-level headlines keep the same cultivated voice at quieter scale where the frame is ledger-led or explanatory.

body.rationale: Longer explanatory copy needs calm, accurate reading and clear compliance boundaries.

utility.rationale: Labels, CTA copy, notes, and professional-role annotations require precise spacing and compact scanning.

cta.rationale: Action labels are understated but unmistakable, with Inter providing a button texture distinct from display copy.

frames.type_scale_relation: Largest display scale on the page; Cormorant headline breaks into three to four desktop lines and stays paired with the portrait slot.

ornaments.anchor: left headline field to portrait placeholder, exiting lower right
ornaments.responsive: Keeps the portrait slot and CTA cluster visible; route may simplify to one bend on mobile.
ornaments.rationale: Introduces the continuous decision route without using broad gold decoration.

frames.type_scale_relation: Short strip; display type is restrained and the four stage signals are utility-supported rather than hero-sized.

ornaments.anchor: upper-right entry across four text stations to lower-center exit
ornaments.responsive: Converts from horizontal signal strip to stacked route without adding station numbers.
ornaments.rationale: Shows career continuity as a pulse, not a statistic bar.

frames.type_scale_relation: Large explanatory display headline on left, compact Inter labels in the professional-role rooms, and a central Cormorant priority label.

ornaments.anchor: upper-center transition marker into room map, reuniting at Your priorities and exiting bottom left
ornaments.responsive: Room map stacks into a vertical convergence diagram while keeping the boundary note visible.
ornaments.rationale: Makes coordination visible without implying one person holds every professional credential.

frames.type_scale_relation: Display headline remains prominent but the continuous phase route is the primary reading structure; phase names use Cormorant at mid-scale.

ornaments.anchor: bottom-left inherited entry through six named phases to lower-right exit
ornaments.responsive: Becomes a vertical connected path on mobile, preserving functional 01-06 numbers only in this section.
ornaments.rationale: Turns the process into a memorable mechanism rather than six equal cards.

frames.type_scale_relation: Quiet ledger scale: smaller display headline, large discipline names, and compact Inter summaries with high negative space.

ornaments.anchor: top-right inherited rule through uneven discipline bands to lower-left exit
ornaments.responsive: Keeps the rule as a structural divider beside stacked disciplines; no row numbers are introduced.
ornaments.rationale: Preserves interdependence across disciplines while avoiding icon-card repetition.

frames.type_scale_relation: Loud mist-blue index; headline is substantial while audience labels and decisions remain crisp Inter-supported editorial notes.

ornaments.anchor: upper-left entry indexing five varied documentary crops to lower-right exit
ornaments.responsive: Rail becomes a left-side mobile index with staggered image crops and no numbered markers.
ornaments.rationale: Lets audiences self-select through context rather than keyword-swapped cards.

frames.type_scale_relation: Quiet portrait essay; headline uses a medium display scale, while verified credentials and body copy stay precise and unembellished.

ornaments.anchor: behind neutral portrait placeholder and exiting lower center
ornaments.responsive: Trace remains behind the portrait slot and must not become a badge or credential seal.
ornaments.rationale: Connects the method to the accountable planner while reserving the real portrait for build time.

frames.type_scale_relation: Closing display headline is large but calmer than the hero; the two decision paths use strong Cormorant labels and Inter summaries.

ornaments.anchor: lower-center entry splitting into strategy call and gated guide paths
ornaments.responsive: Splits into two stacked decisions on mobile with the guide availability note always visible.
ornaments.rationale: Makes the conversion choice honest and structural rather than urgency driven.

context_checks: Neutral reserved logo area appears without redesigning the identity.
Cormorant Garamond display headline is rendered with controlled desktop and mobile line breaks.
Inter body copy, utility labels, disclaimer, and CTA labels are rendered with clear contrast.
Hero/media treatment is shown beside live type to prove scale and overlap constraints.

art_director_rationale: The fixed brand families are strong enough for Direction A when Cormorant Garamond carries lyrical authority and Inter stays precise, clinical, and restrained. The line-break rules protect the editorial cadence and prevent the builder from turning the design into generic card-led SaaS typography.
builder_freedom: The builder may tune exact clamp values within each approved role if the specified line counts and hierarchy remain intact.
The builder may simplify gold-line bends responsively as long as the entry and exit behavior remains continuous.
The builder may use Next.js font optimization or local bundled files, but must keep Cormorant Garamond and Inter as the only approved families.
